title.en: Timber seating set on a decked terrace

alt.tr: Cam kapılı evin deck terasında ahşap kanepe, koltuklar ve orta masa
alt.en: Timber sofa, armchairs and centre table on the decked terrace of a house with glass doors

caption.tr: Koltuk takımı kanepe, iki koltuk ve orta masadan oluşuyor. Cilalı ahşap, deck zemine iyi oturmuş.
caption.en: The set has a sofa, two armchairs and a centre table. The varnished timber sits well on the deck floor.
